title: Kissed Welsh Garlic Welsh Ploughman's Platter
description: A crispy and savory Welsh Ploughman's platter kissed with garlicky flavors and Marsala wine notes. Perfect for a midnight craving!
instructions: Cut the bread into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the reduced Marsala wine over the bread and toss to coat.
Dot the bread with unsalted butter and sprinkle with minced garlic.
Transfer the bread to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the bread is baking, melt 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped parsley and cook until wilted.
Stir in the full-fat coconut cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Remove the bread from the oven and let cool slightly.
Transfer the bread to a large serving platter or individual plates.
Top the bread with shredded cheddar cheese, cured meats, pickled onions, and a dollop of parsley-coconut cream.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
